name: ADAT Lightpipe

policy._this_is_a_policy: Ce qu'il faut supposer quand l'appareil n'a rien dit, pas une mesure. Une fiche qui connaît son vrai chiffre l'emporte.

note: ADAT carries eight channels at 44.1 or 48 kHz on one optical fibre. Higher rates exist only by sample multiplexing (S/MUX), which trades channels for rate: four channels at 88.2/96 kHz, two at 176.4/192 kHz. So on this interface the rate and the channel count cannot both be read from the device's ceiling, and a record that states 192 kHz is stating a two-channel mode. DoP is not used over ADAT in practice and no maker in this catalogue claims it.
